title: File:2 Gold Bronze Age bracelets (FindID 266606).jpg
desc:
Two middle Bronze Age ribbon torcs.
Description
1. A gold ribbon torc with hooks at both ends which has been folded and bent in eight places. A narrow thicker section of un-hammered wire has been left in the centre of the torc and at both ends. The latter narrow lengths have been folded back on them

title: File:An incomplete post medieval copper alloy book clasp dating to the late 16th century. (FindID 599700).jpg
desc: An incomplete Post Medieval copper alloy book clasp dating to the late 16th century. The object would have been formed from a single sheetof copper alloy, folded around a book cover to form a clasp. The front plate consists of a rectangular plate with a rectangular tab at one end and a serrated fan

title: File:DUR-4BF5EB (FindID 870121-633453).jpg
desc:
Description: A complete cast gold Reson or Posie finger ring, with a floriate and foliate pattern and interior 'Black Letter' inscription, dating to the late medieval period (AD1350-1500).
The outer surface of the gold ring has thin parallel bands running around the upper and lower edges of the band
